import os, subprocess, time, sys
t='/dev/cu.usbserial-1130'
if not os.path.exists(t):
    print('STRESS_SKIPPED target_missing'); raise SystemExit(2)
busy=subprocess.run(['lsof',t],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()
if busy:
    print('STRESS_SKIPPED target_busy'); print(busy); raise SystemExit(2)
import serial
fail=[]
for cycle in range(1,6):
    print(f'CYCLE_{cycle}_BEGIN')
    r=subprocess.run(['esptool.py','--port',t,'chip_id'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=25)
    print('RESET_RC',r.returncode)
    if r.returncode:
        print(r.stdout[-2000:]); print(r.stderr[-2000:]); fail.append((cycle,'reset_failed')); print(f'CYCLE_{cycle}_END'); continue
    time.sleep(0.35)
    s=serial.Serial(); s.port=t; s.baudrate=115200; s.timeout=0.25; s.dtr=False; s.rts=False; s.open()
    start=time.monotonic(); lines=[]
    while time.monotonic()-start < 16.0:
        raw=s.readline()
        if raw: lines.append((time.monotonic()-start,raw.decode('utf-8',errors='replace').rstrip()))
    s.close()
    scd_ok=any('scd_sample=1' in x and 'scd_samples=' in x for _,x in lines)
    eink_ok=any('Physical refresh completed' in x for _,x in lines)
    eink_enabled=any('eink_requested=1' in x and 'eink_ready=1' in x for _,x in lines)
    panic=any(('Guru Meditation' in x or 'panic' in x.lower() or 'abort' in x.lower()) for _,x in lines)
    brown=any('brownout' in x.lower() for _,x in lines)
    fw=any('firmware_sha=a92074b74b055c58c0949c7c38f4896638ebf227' in x for _,x in lines)
    print('RESULT',f'scd_ok={int(scd_ok)} eink_ok={int(eink_ok)} eink_enabled={int(eink_enabled)} panic={int(panic)} brownout={int(brown)} firmware_ok={int(fw)} lines={len(lines)}')
    print('CYCLE_TIMELINE_BEGIN')
    keys=('rst:0x','I2C probe','scd_','scd41','eink_display','Stage27 real-input runtime','Guru Meditation','panic','brownout')
    for dt,x in lines:
        if any(k.lower() in x.lower() for k in keys): print(f'{dt:06.2f}s | {x}')
    print('CYCLE_TIMELINE_END')
    if not (scd_ok and eink_ok and eink_enabled and fw and not panic and not brown):
        fail.append((cycle,'qualification_failed'))
    print(f'CYCLE_{cycle}_END')
print('STRESS_FAILURES',fail)
if fail: raise SystemExit(3)
print('STRESS_PASS cycles=5')
